mira (oncall): paging: EU canary for inference-service v1.9 showing 5xx spike ~ 12:43 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback. tagging @dev-jen and @infra-raj :rotating_light:

sre-bot: INCIDENT created · severity: SEV2 · runbook: deploy-rollback · pager: mira (oncall)

dev-jen: on it. did the staged canary rollout finish? any traffic-shaping?

mira (oncall): canary finished ~ +10m ago. metrics: 5xx rate jumped to 4.7% in eu-west-1, baseline 0.05%. p50 latency +80ms.

infra-raj: flipping kill-switch flag now: `flagctl set deploy_eu_v1_9 false`

dev-jen: flag flipped :thumbsup: but errors not dropping — looks like some requests still hitting v1.9.

ops-dmitri: possible stale routing entries on edge LB or proxy cache. I'm going to evict canary pods and force drain on the pool. running: ```kubectl label pods -l rollout=canary eu-canary=evict && kubectl drain node node-eu-xx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

infra-raj: also checking traffic router: found 3 sticky sessions bound to the new variant. clearing session keys on proxy (gone through session-service).```
